name: verifiable-settlement
description: Verifiable event-driven settlement on Hedera: oracle attestation, HCS evidence, a Solidity SettlementRouter, HTS credit and Mirror Node audit. Next.js + Hardhat + a shared TypeScript SDK.

envVars.description: Network the app targets: testnet, mainnet or local. Defaults to testnet when empty.
JSON-RPC relay URL for the selected network. Empty uses the public Hashio endpoint, which is for development and testing only.
Mirror Node REST URL for the selected network. Empty uses the public Hedera Mirror Node.
Server-side operator account ID (0.0.x) that publishes HCS messages and manages HTS.
Server-side operator private key. Secret: never commit it and never expose it to the browser.
Encrypted deployer key written by the account script. Do not fill it manually.
Base URL of the oracle provider.
API key of the oracle provider, when the provider requires one.

steps.label: Create your local environment file
steps.text: Fill in only what you need. The file is git-ignored. Never commit keys.
